title: shot
description: A shot list shot into a level sequence: each shot's camera (framed by the solver, taken from the scene's coverage, or placed), its moves, lens and focus, and the camera cuts. Converges (shot.apply): the same spec again changes nothing.

sequence.description: the level sequence package path (made if missing): /Game/Films/<id>/Seq_<scene>

start_frame.description: where the first shot starts when it has no start (default 0)

end_frame.description: where the last shot ends when it has no end

timing.description: WP12's audio timing document (kind audio) inlined: its lines and words give the marks

subjects.description: who the shots frame: name -> {actor: label} (skeleton, else bounds) or {points: {landmark: [x,y,z]}, facing}

top_z.description: the crown's height cm when hair or a hat raise it

filmback.description: a preset name or [w, h] mm (default 16:9 Digital Film)

camera_prefix.description: camera labels are prefix + shot id (default CAM_)

height.description: eye | high | low | slight high | slight low | overhead | worm (elevations seen from the eyes), degrees, shoulder | chest | hip | knee | ground (the lens at that landmark), or {z: cm}

noise.description: handheld noise: subtle | handheld | documentary | breathing | shake, or {preset, seed, scale, pos (cm), rot (deg), hz}

tail_s.description: seconds the last shot holds after the last line (default 1)

coverage.description: how the scene's coverage is planned (for coverage: shots and auto)

side.description: the side of the line from the first subject to the second, seen from above

height.description: eye | high | low | slight high | slight low | overhead | worm (elevations seen from the eyes), degrees, shoulder | chest | hip | knee | ground (the lens at that landmark), or {z: cm}

auto.description: cut the dialogue: the master, then each line on its speaker's single, cutting lead_frames early

size.description: shot size: ECU CU MCU MS COWBOY MWS WS EWS, or an alias (close-up, medium, wide, full, ...; cam.presets lists them)

start.description: frames (int), '48f', '2.5s', or a mark: a line or shot id with .start/.end ('L2.start-6f', 'S1.end'), a word 'L1.w3.start'

end.description: frames (int), '48f', '2.5s', or a mark: a line or shot id with .start/.end ('L2.start-6f', 'S1.end'), a word 'L1.w3.start'

duration.description: frames (int), '48f', '2.5s', or a mark: a line or shot id with .start/.end ('L2.start-6f', 'S1.end'), a word 'L1.w3.start'

camera.description: the camera label (default prefix + id); two shots may share one

frame.description: frame subjects by shot grammar: the solver places the camera (cam.frame)

subjects.description: subject names (shot) or actor labels (camera); several = a two-shot / group

size.description: shot size: ECU CU MCU MS COWBOY MWS WS EWS, or an alias (close-up, medium, wide, full, ...; cam.presets lists them)

angle.description: degrees around from the first subject's facing toward its `side`, or front | 1/4 | 3/4 | profile | 3/4 back | back

side.description: the subject's own left or right

height.description: eye | high | low | slight high | slight low | overhead | worm (elevations seen from the eyes), degrees, shoulder | chest | hip | knee | ground (the lens at that landmark), or {z: cm}

focal_mm.description: focal length mm; the distance is solved (null with distance_cm: the focal length is solved)

distance_cm.description: horizontal distance eyes to lens, cm; with focal_mm null/absent the focal length is solved

place.description: where the eyes sit across the frame: auto | center | left third | right third | u 0..1

headroom.description: v (0 top..1 bottom) of the head's top; default per size

snap_focal.description: round a solved focal length to a standard prime and re-solve the distance

lead.description: the third's position for thirds placement (default 1/3)

margin.description: side margin a group must fit inside (fraction of width, default 0.06)

items.description: a camera move (docs/unreal/camera.md): dolly push_in pull_out truck pedestal crane orbit arc pan tilt roll zoom dolly_zoom whip rack follow hold, with its args (distance cm, fraction, degrees, rise cm, reach cm, swing deg, focal mm, to cm, radius cm) and frames | from/to, ease

frames.description: length in frames (default the whole shot when it is the only move, else 48)

noise.description: handheld noise: subtle | handheld | documentary | breathing | shake, or {preset, seed, scale, pos (cm), rot (deg), hz}

focus.description: a subject name (follow-focus on its eyes), [x,y,z], {distance_cm}, or off/manual
